This is a demo of the two tree grids of ui-components, showing a tree of life, fungi, animals and plants, with the scientific names, the ranks, the periods and the times of their groups and species, the way from the animals to the dinosaurs expanded.
  • The first pill, TreeGrid: a tree grid of Wicket components, a TableTree of wicket-extensions whose tree column renders the nodes of Tree, with the icons of ui-components. The other columns are ordinary columns of a DataTable; expanding a group repaints the table through Ajax
  • The second pill, JsonBasedTreeGrid: a JsonBasedTree shown as a WAI-ARIA treegrid, a single component whose rows are rendered in the browser from JSON. The tree column renders the template of the node, each other column a template of its own from the same JSON; the children of a group follow its row, loaded the first time it is expanded
  • The drop-down above them chooses whether the user can resize the columns of both by dragging the right edge of a header, and how: keeping the width of the table, a column taking its width from its neighbour (setResizableColumns(Mode.FIT)), or stretching the table as a column grows (Mode.STRETCH)
  • Groups are selected as well as species (setSelectBranches(true)): click the row of a group, such as the dinosaurs, and its card is shown on the right, repainted through Ajax by onSelect, its row marked as selected and the group expanded if it was not. Click a species, such as Tyrannosaurus rex, and the right shows its lineage, the card of its group and, below it, the card of the species. The arrow of a group still only expands or collapses it
  • In JsonBasedTreeGrid, Tab moves to the rows; Up and Down move between them, Right and Left expand and collapse a group or move to its first child and its parent, Home and End go to the first and the last row, and Enter or Space selects a group or a species
  • The headers, the names, the ranks, the periods and the times are written in the language of the session
  • Both tree grids are private components: without a license key activating them they render a placeholder instead
  • "Icons" above the trees chooses their icons: their own, the Font Awesome icons as inline SVG (SvgIcon), or the same drawn by the Font Awesome font (FontAwesomeIcon), given to the trees with setIcon(TreeIcon, IIcon). The arrows of the groups turn whatever icon they are; the React and Svelte tabs choose them the same way, through the icons of their trees

The React and Svelte tabs show the same tree in the TreeGrid of @antilia/react and @antilia/svelte, with the same columns and the prop selectBranches, loaded from the mounted resource /api/tree-of-life; the cards of what is selected are shown by the app itself. Ma stands for millions of years ago.
